plugins.name: design-buddy
plugins.description: A repo-agnostic design partner: adversarially debated designs, evidence-grounded implementation plans, and a strict plan-review gate — from bug fixes to rearchitectures.

plugins.name: context-forge
plugins.description: A context-engineering toolkit: context-constitution reverse-engineers a repo's non-obvious tribal knowledge into an evidence-cited context-constitution.md plus a behavioral contract in CLAUDE.md; context-scrubber audits the repo's context files and reports every line that fails the litmus test — stale citations, restated facts, duplication, contradictions, just-in-time, brittle instructions, bloat — plus a file-level context-budget signal, with an optional gated trim. Adds the high-signal context, removes the low-signal; invents nothing, every rule and verdict is grounded.
